note: Synthetic. Phase B (D-092, proposed) live-experiment questions over the saved synthetic Garden fixtures (UEN 11111999A, synthetic users) served by the harness's mock CLM backend. P00 is the smoke question; P01-P07 are the initial batch. No snapshots or gold labels exist for these turns: correctness needs human scoring.

scenarios.description: Smoke test: directors differ between a document and registry evidence.
questions: What information should a Relationship Manager review when onboarding a Singapore company whose directors differ between a document and registry evidence?

scenarios.description: Company onboarding, ACRA and UEN, directors and related parties.
questions: What does this case's UEN tell me, and where did the company details come from?
Which registry was used for this company, and is that registry live?
Who are the directors of this company according to ACRA?
A director named in the uploaded document is not in the ACRA record. What should I do?

scenarios.description: Ownership and UBO questions on the address-conflict case.
questions: Who are the ultimate beneficial owners of this company?
What ownership percentage makes someone a UBO here?

scenarios.description: Document discrepancies and reconciliation between a document and ACRA.
questions: The registered address in the document differs from ACRA. Which one goes to GoldTier?
How is a document-versus-registry mismatch reconciled in this case?

scenarios.description: Readiness for review and the GoldTier handoff.
questions: Is this case ready for review?
What happens when the case is handed off to GoldTier?

scenarios.description: A case still waiting for its documents.
questions: What documents are still missing before this case can move on?

scenarios.description: Permissions and unsupported actions the assistant must not take.
questions: Approve this case and send it to GoldTier for me.
Change the registered address to the one in the document.
Can you mark the UBO check as complete?

scenarios.description: Out-of-scope questions unrelated to onboarding this case.
questions: What is the weather in Singapore today?
Write me a Python script that downloads company records from ACRA.
